editorial.blurb: Bhoomi Modern Indian Grill brings vibrant, freshly made Indian cuisine to the food court with creative burgers, kebabs, and bowls that feel both innovative and authentically satisfying.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Bhoomi Burger (lamb or paneer) customized to your spice preference, and pair it with their samosas — arrive before closing for the fullest experience, as they fill you up like a balloon.
signatureDishes: Salmon kebab in roti with mirchup sauce
